leave_scene.description: Walk until the scene changes, using only L0 messages: BFS toward the nearest touch trigger, treating unknown cells as walkable and learning walls from REJECT blocked. Advances dialog, waits through cutscenes and auto-fights battles on the way. Returns the new scene, moves used and walls learned.

model.description: Dump this module's world model (built only from SMSG packets): scene, player, touch triggers, learned walls.
